answer: A sybil cluster forging identities would need to acquire and stake distinct marbles per fake node while surviving continuous cross-peer checks, so attack cost scales linearly with identity count. Each agent must stake a unique marble token bound to a verified hardware root, and every attestation it signs emits a ripple visible across the ledger. Honest agents see the true reputation horizon, and colluders pay real stake plus detection risk for negligible gain. In practice, sa0014 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
